required_contracts: channel capability remains local to its execution domain
bounded capacity 0 is rendezvous, never silently buffered
ordinary zero-capacity receive must register a rendezvous reader; polling without registration must never deadlock
positive bounded capacity enforces FIFO and backpressure
send and receive suspend cooperatively; scheduler carrier is never parked
nb operations register a Future; try operations do not register
try_send Full and Closed preserve the original moved value
close is idempotent, queued data drains before terminal EOF
closed/empty is not conflated with temporarily-unready None
cancelled pending operations remove their registrations exactly once
borrowed and callable payloads do not cross prohibited channel boundaries
unbounded is separate and MUST NOT map to arbitrary large finite capacity
actor DATA graph attachment (including legacy two-port pipes) rejects preexisting buffered data and pending public reader registrations before claiming channel ownership

cancelling a pending read must unlink the matching registration exactly once, preserve other readers in FIFO order including head/middle/tail removal, and never interpret a cancelled Future as a normal closed-channel EOF
registered pending writes preserve FIFO relative to earlier queued writes and non-registering sends; zero-capacity reads must rendezvous without buffering
cancelling or closing an uncommitted write preserves the original payload for exactly one recovery; committed payloads cannot be recovered or delivered twice
actor DATA graph ownership rejects channels with queued public pending writers as well as readers and buffered data
channel payload construction must reject dynamic Any, nested channel capabilities, and mutable containers unless a borrow checker proves transfer safety
